name: Backprojection via Shepard's Interpolation
definition: A technique to fit a continuous scale field S(x) from a discrete set of LoG extrema N={(xi,ti)} by interpolating the representative scales ti using basis functions, allowing for a smooth transfer function.
summary: Backprojection via Shepard's Interpolation constructs a continuous scale field from discrete extrema using Wendland polynomials, offering C2 continuity and compact support to prevent scale bleeding.
